metadata.source: Hand-authored demo ruleset based on common Contoso procurement / legal policies
metadata.note: This ruleset is for end-to-end testing only. A production deployment would author rules from the actual Contoso policy PDFs via an LLM-backed authoring agent.
metadata.changelog: v2.2.0 — eval-003 hardening (#65): tightened LIAB-001/LIAB-CARVEOUTS/WAR-001/INDM-001 with `!is_country_supplement` so master-clause rules don't misfire on per-country supplements; relaxed LIAB-CARVEOUTS lambda to any one explicit carve-out; switched PAY-INT-MAX to `percent_max_per_month` so 18%/annum is correctly evaluated against 1.5%/mo; broadened PRIV-CONSENT lambda to recognize generic `consents to` phrasing. v2.1.0 — accuracy hardening per ruleset-accuracy-eval-001.md: tightened liability + tax-exclusivity predicates so each rule fires on its operative section only; rewrote AI-PRIVACY-SUPP without a vacuous-true conditional; switched insurance and payment lambdas onto per-keyword features (dollar_for_cyber, dollar_for_gcl, day_count_for_payment) instead of section-aggregate maxes; strengthened CONF-001 / TERM-001 to require an actual numeric duration; relies on engine-side party-alias resolution so PRIV-72H matches `Company`-aliased Contoso; per-rule `anchor` regexes drive substring-precise markup.

rules.naturalLanguage: Confidentiality clause must define a survival period (years) for the NDA obligations.
rules.remediation: Add an explicit survival period (e.g., "obligations survive for five (5) years from termination") to the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Limitation of liability must reference an explicit dollar cap or fee multiplier.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("$") || input1.text.Contains("fees paid") || input1.text.Contains("amount paid") || input1.text.Contains("twelve months") || input1.text.Contains("12 months") || input1.text.Contains("12-month")
rules.remediation: Add an explicit cap to the {section.heading} clause: "In no event shall total liability exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim."

rules.naturalLanguage: Limitation of liability must carve out gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP indemnity, confidentiality breach, and data breach.
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("gross negligence") || input1.text.Contains("willful misconduct") || input1.text.Contains("wilful misconduct") || input1.text.Contains("fraud") || input1.text.Contains("infringement") || input1.text.Contains("intellectual property") || input1.text.Contains("IP indemnity") || input1.text.Contains("confidential") || input1.text.Contains("data breach") || input1.text.Contains("personal data"))
rules.remediation: Carve out gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP indemnity, confidentiality breach, and data-breach liability from the cap in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Warranties must include a defined remedy / cure period.
rules.remediation: Specify a cure window in the {section.heading} clause (e.g., "Provider shall correct non-conforming Services within thirty (30) days").

rules.naturalLanguage: Termination clause must specify a written-notice period of at least 30 days.
rules.remediation: Update the {section.heading} clause to require at least sixty (60) calendar days prior written notice to terminate for convenience.

rules.naturalLanguage: Termination for convenience must be a unilateral Contoso right (not symmetric).
rules.lambda: !(input1.text.Contains("Either party may terminate") || input1.text.Contains("either party may terminate") || input1.text.Contains("each party may terminate"))
rules.remediation: Re-cast the {section.heading} clause so termination for convenience is exercisable by Contoso only.

rules.naturalLanguage: Indemnification clause must address third-party IP infringement (defend Contoso against IP-infringement claims).
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("defend") || input1.text.Contains("defense")) && (input1.text.Contains("infringement") || input1.text.Contains("infringe") || input1.text.Contains("intellectual property") || input1.text.Contains("IP claim") || input1.text.Contains("third-party claim") || input1.text.Contains("third party claim"))
rules.remediation: Ensure the {section.heading} clause requires the supplier to defend Contoso against third-party IP infringement claims.

rules.naturalLanguage: Payment terms must be no more than 45 days (Net 45 or shorter).
rules.remediation: Shorten the payment term in the {section.heading} clause to forty-five (45) days or fewer (e.g., Net 45).

rules.naturalLanguage: Late-payment interest must not exceed 1.5% per month.
rules.remediation: Cap late-payment interest in the {section.heading} clause at 1.5% per month or the maximum permitted by law, whichever is lower.

rules.naturalLanguage: Pricing must be exclusive of applicable taxes (taxes are added on top, not bundled in).
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("exclusive of") || input1.text.Contains("fees exclude") || input1.text.Contains("exclude any tax") || input1.text.Contains("excludes tax") || input1.text.Contains("excluding tax")) && (input1.text.Contains("tax") || input1.text.Contains("taxes"))
rules.remediation: State explicitly in the {section.heading} clause that all prices are exclusive of applicable taxes (GST/HST/QST/withholding) and are added at invoice.

rules.naturalLanguage: Deliverables must vest in Contoso as works made for hire (or be irrevocably assigned).
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("Contoso") && (input1.text.Contains("works made for hire") || input1.text.Contains("work made for hire") || input1.text.Contains("assigned to") || input1.text.Contains("hereby assigns"))
rules.remediation: Add language to the {section.heading} clause that all Deliverables are "works made for hire" for Contoso, or are irrevocably assigned to Contoso upon creation.

rules.naturalLanguage: General Commercial Liability (GCL) insurance must be at least $5,000,000 per occurrence.
rules.remediation: Increase the General Commercial Liability limit in the {section.heading} clause to at least $5,000,000 per occurrence.

rules.naturalLanguage: Cyber liability insurance must be at least $10,000,000 per claim.
rules.remediation: Increase the cyber-liability limit in the {section.heading} clause to at least $10,000,000 per claim.

rules.naturalLanguage: Security clause must specify AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
rules.remediation: Specify AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher in transit in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Personal data of personal data must remain in Canada (Contoso policy).
rules.lambda: !(input1.text.Contains("any country") || input1.text.Contains("any other country") || input1.text.Contains("transfer outside") || input1.text.Contains("transferred to") || input1.text.Contains("transferred, stored and processed") || input1.text.Contains("processed outside Canada") || input1.text.Contains("United States or any"))
rules.remediation: Restrict cross-border transfer of Canadian personal data in the {section.heading} clause: data must be stored and processed in Canada per Contoso policy.

rules.naturalLanguage: Privacy breach must be notified to Contoso and the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (PIPEDA: as soon as feasible).
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("Privacy Commissioner") || input1.text.Contains("OPC") || input1.text.Contains("as soon as feasible")) && input1.text.Contains("Contoso")
rules.remediation: Require breach notification to Contoso and to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC) "as soon as feasible" in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Personal-data consent must follow PIPEDA explicit-consent standard (not Vendor's discretion).
rules.lambda: !(input1.text.Contains("Vendor's discretion") || input1.text.Contains("Vendor discretion") || input1.text.Contains("Provider's discretion") || input1.text.Contains("Provider discretion") || input1.text.Contains("Microsoft's discretion") || input1.text.Contains("Microsoft discretion")) && (input1.text.Contains("explicit consent") || input1.text.Contains("informed consent") || input1.text.Contains("PIPEDA") || input1.text.Contains("consents to") || input1.text.Contains("obtain all required consents"))
rules.remediation: Replace any "at Vendor's discretion" consent language in the {section.heading} clause with PIPEDA explicit-consent obligations.

rules.naturalLanguage: Personal-data retention must be capped (e.g., no more than 7 years post-termination).
rules.remediation: Specify a maximum retention period (e.g., seven (7) years from termination) for personal data in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Privacy clause must explicitly enumerate PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25 (and GDPR where applicable).
rules.remediation: Enumerate PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, and (where applicable) GDPR in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Contracts that process Contoso data via AI must reference an AI Addendum.
rules.remediation: Reference the Contoso AI Addendum in the {section.heading} clause whenever AI/ML processes Contoso data.

rules.naturalLanguage: AI processing of Contoso data must reference the Privacy T&Cs Supplement.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("Privacy T&C") || input1.text.Contains("Privacy Terms") || input1.text.Contains("Privacy Supplement")
rules.remediation: Reference the Contoso Privacy T&Cs Supplement in the {section.heading} clause when AI processes Contoso data.

rules.naturalLanguage: Subcontracting requires Contoso's prior written approval.
rules.remediation: Require Contoso's prior written approval before any subcontracting in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Service-delivery locations must be approved by Contoso.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("approved by Contoso") || input1.text.Contains("Contoso approves") || input1.text.Contains("Contoso-approved")
rules.remediation: Restrict service-delivery locations to those approved by Contoso in the {section.heading} clause.

rules.naturalLanguage: Governing law must be Quebec; venue Montreal.
rules.remediation: Set governing law to the Province of Quebec and venue to Montreal in the {section.heading} clause.
